title: Reader Chapter 25
hook: A reader-facing chapter under phase-1 review.

examples.title: Ruxandra stops over the cracked blue mug
examples.scenario: Ruxandra holds a chipped blue mug at Tuesday 6:42 p.m. in the Midtown design studio review room, creative director, with the first page of a performance memo. Her draft says the junior designer missed three client beats. The facts are right, but Ruxandra keeps deleting the opening line because she can already hear the shame in the room. Ruxandra she must decide whether to lead with dates or name the three layers before Derek arrives.
examples.whyItMatters: It shows the skill in context.

examples.title: Zanele balances the clipboard on a pallet
examples.scenario: Zanele steadies a dented clipboard at Thursday 5:11 a.m. in dock door 3 at the Albany bakery, shipping lead, with a stack of warm bread crates. The driver says the count was short. The packer says the order sheet changed after midnight. Zanele can prove the timestamp, yet the driver's empty shelves are also real. Zanele she must decide whether to win the count or draw both paths on the back of the sheet.
examples.whyItMatters: It shows the skill in context.
